<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges with retrieve_carbon_shifts to identify which signals correspond to aromatic carbons (generally ~110–160 ppm). By counting the signals that fall within that aromatic range, I can provide the integer count of aromatic carbons.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
